PLAIN_LANGUAGE.LABEL: Plain-language tips
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.INTRO: Plain language (B1): tips only, nothing is blocked.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.LONG_SENTENCE: This sentence has {{words}} words. Keep it to {{limit}} or fewer: split it in two.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.PASSIVE_NL: “{{match}}” is passive. Say who does it, e.g. “we sturen u” instead of “u wordt gestuurd”.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.PASSIVE_EN: “{{match}}” is passive. Say who does it, e.g. “we will send” instead of “will be sent”.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.AND_OR: “{{match}}” asks two things at once. Ask one thing per question.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.TWO_QUESTIONS: This asks two questions. Make it two separate questions.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.JOINED_QUESTIONS: “{{match}} …” starts a second question. Ask it separately.

FORM_LANGUAGE.TITLE: Language
FORM_LANGUAGE.LABEL: Form language
FORM_LANGUAGE.HINT: The language the questions are written in. It tells screen readers and browsers which language to read them in.

PDF_IMPORT.WAITING_FOR_READER: Waiting for the document reader to become available. The import continues by itself.
PDF_IMPORT.DRAFT_REMOVED: Nothing was added to your forms list: the empty draft form was removed.
PDF_IMPORT.DRAFT_KEPT: Your draft form was kept because it already had changes.

encrypted.MESSAGE: This PDF is protected with a password.
encrypted.NEXT: Remove the password (for example by printing it to a new PDF) and upload it again.

unreadable.MESSAGE: This file could not be read. It may be damaged or not a real PDF or image.
unreadable.NEXT: Open it on your computer and save or print it to a new PDF, then upload that. Or try another file.

too_many_pages.MESSAGE: This document has more pages than one import can take.
too_many_pages.NEXT: Split it into smaller parts, for example one per section, and import each part.

too_large.MESSAGE: This file is too large to import.
too_large.NEXT: Upload a smaller file: reduce the image size, or split the document into parts.

too_complex.MESSAGE: This document holds more content than a form import can handle.
too_complex.NEXT: Try a simpler version, or split the document and import the parts one by one.

timeout.MESSAGE: Reading this document took too long.
timeout.NEXT: Try again. If it happens again, split the document into smaller parts or try another file.

empty.MESSAGE: This file has no pages or no content.
empty.NEXT: Check that you chose the right file and try another one.

unsupported_type.MESSAGE: This kind of file cannot be imported.
unsupported_type.NEXT: Upload a PDF, or a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo of the form.

no_questions.MESSAGE: No questions were found in this document.
no_questions.NEXT: Try a clearer scan or photo, or a PDF in which you can select the text. You can also build the form yourself.
no_questions.NEXT_WITHOUT_AI: Only the built-in reader was used, and it cannot read scans or photos. Upload a PDF in which you can select the text, or allow AI reading for this upload if your workspace uses AI.

unavailable.MESSAGE: The document reader is not available right now.
unavailable.NEXT: Try again in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, contact support.

failed.MESSAGE: Something went wrong while importing this document.
failed.NEXT: Try again. If it keeps happening, contact support.

START_ERROR.import_in_progress: Another import is still running in this workspace. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
START_ERROR.daily_limit: This workspace has reached its number of imports for the last 24 hours. Try again later.
START_ERROR.too_large: This file is too large to import. Upload a smaller file or split the document.
START_ERROR.unsupported_type: Choose a PDF, or a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo of a form.
START_ERROR.empty: This file is empty. Choose another file.
START_ERROR.upload_failed: The upload failed. Please try again.

THEME.HEADING: Type and shape
THEME.DATA_FONT_HINT: The submission number and other values respondents may copy or read back.
THEME.WIDE_TITLES_HINT: Sets titles a quarter wider, in Archivo's wide cut.
THEME.RADIUS_HINT: Of fields, answer options and buttons. Any choice but Default also letters the answer options (A, B, C) so they can be chosen with a key.
THEME.BUTTONS_HINT_OUTLINED: The button's edge and text take a colour that reads on the page.
THEME.HIGHLIGHT_HINT: The chosen answer and the notes beside a question. Where it is too light to read on the page, the text colour is used.
THEME.SELECTION_HINT: The chosen answer only; the highlight keeps the notes. Where it is too light to read on the page, the text colour is used.
THEME.SELECTION_NONE: Uses the highlight, else the button colour.
THEME.GALLERY_HINT: Every preset meets WCAG AA contrast. Pick one to see it on the form.
THEME.CONTRAST_PASSES: Readable: text reaches 4.5:1 and controls 3:1 (WCAG AA).
THEME.CONTRAST_FAILS_one: One colour pair is hard to read. Fix it before you save or publish this theme.
THEME.CONTRAST_FAILS_other: {{count}} colour pairs are hard to read. Fix them before you save or publish this theme.
THEME.CONTRAST_ISSUE_TEXT: Questions and text on the page
THEME.CONTRAST_ISSUE_ANSWER: Answers in the white input boxes
THEME.CONTRAST_ISSUE_ACTION: Chosen answers, icons and progress on the page
THEME.CONTRAST_IMAGE: Text over an image can't be measured. Preview the form to check it stays readable.
THEME.CONTRAST_SAVE_BLOCKED: This theme can't be saved yet: some colours are hard to read. Use the suggested colours or pick others.

DIALOG.TITLE: Import from Open Formulieren
DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: Upload the zip file you exported from an Open Formulieren form. We make a draft form from it and list everything we could not carry over.
DIALOG.DROP: Drop a zip file here, or click to choose
DIALOG.DROP_HINT: One form per zip file, up to 5 MB
DIALOG.CHOSEN: {{size}} MB · click to choose another file
DIALOG.KEEP: The zip file is not kept. Only the draft form and the import report are saved.

ERROR.open_formulieren_off: Importing from Open Formulieren is switched off on this server.
ERROR.file_missing: No file was sent. Choose a zip file and try again.
ERROR.file_too_large: This file is too large. The limit is {{mb}} MB. Export the form again without extra files, or choose a smaller zip.
ERROR.not_a_zip: This is not a zip file. Use the zip you get from the Export action in Open Formulieren.
ERROR.archive_unsafe: This zip file has entries we cannot open safely, so we did not read it. Export the form again.
ERROR.archive_too_large: This zip file holds too much data to read. Export the form again.
ERROR.archive_incomplete: This zip file is not a complete Open Formulieren export. It is missing: {{files}}.
ERROR.archive_json_invalid: We could not read the file “{{file}}” in the zip. Export the form again.
ERROR.archive_not_a_single_form: This zip file must hold exactly one form. Export one form at a time.
ERROR.open_formulieren_version_unknown: We could not tell which Open Formulieren version made this file. Export the form again from an up-to-date installation.
ERROR.open_formulieren_version_unsupported: This file comes from Open Formulieren {{version}}. We can only read exports from version {{supported}}.
ERROR.no_importable_fields: Nothing in this form can be imported as a question, so no form was made.
ERROR.archive_too_complex: This form has more pages or questions than one form can hold. Split it in Open Formulieren and import the parts.
ERROR.import_not_found: We could not find this import.
ERROR.forbidden: You are not allowed to create forms in this workspace.
ERROR.upload_failed: The import failed. Please try again.

REASON.unsupported_component_type: This question type (“{{componentType}}”) is not supported, so it was left out.
REASON.unknown_component_type: We do not know the question type “{{componentType}}”, so it was left out.
REASON.always_hidden: This question is always hidden in the source form, so it was left out.
REASON.not_allowed_in_repeating_group: A question of type “{{componentType}}” cannot be in a repeating group, so it was left out.
REASON.converted_to_text: This question of type “{{componentType}}” became a short text question.
REASON.converted_to_number: This question became a number question.
REASON.converted_to_yes_no: This question became a yes or no question.
REASON.datetime_split: This date and time question became two questions: one for the date and one for the time.
REASON.checkbox_required_not_enforced: This checkbox was required. The new form does not require it to be ticked.
REASON.national_identity_number: This question asks for a national identity number. Check that you need it.
REASON.multiple_not_supported: In the source form people could give more than one answer. Here they can give one.
REASON.choices_from_variable: The choices came from a variable. They were not carried over.
REASON.too_few_choices: This question has too few choices. Add at least two.
REASON.default_value_not_carried: The preset answer was not carried over.
REASON.validation_not_carried: A check on the answer (“{{property}}”) was not carried over.
REASON.file_restrictions_not_carried: The limits on file type and size were not carried over.
REASON.custom_script_dropped: Custom code (“{{property}}”) was not carried over.
REASON.prefill_not_carried: Prefilling from “{{plugin}}” was not carried over.
REASON.date_rule_not_carried: A rule for the allowed dates was not carried over.
REASON.disabled_not_carried: The setting that stops people from changing this answer was not carried over.
REASON.second_text_not_carried: The extra text for this question was not carried over.
REASON.empty_step: This page had no questions we could import, so it is empty.
REASON.trigger_not_supported: A rule starts in a way we do not support, so it was left out.
REASON.action_not_supported: A rule does something we do not support (“{{actionType}}”), so it was left out.
REASON.conflicting_rules: Some rules conflict with each other. Check how this question is shown.
REASON.condition_source_missing: A rule uses a question that is not in the form, so it was left out.
REASON.target_missing: A rule points to a question that is not in the form, so it was left out.
REASON.condition_value_not_supported: A rule compares an answer in a way we do not support, so it was left out.
REASON.user_variable_not_carried: This variable (type “{{dataType}}”) was not carried over.
REASON.sign_in_not_carried: Sign in with “{{plugin}}” was not carried over. Respondents do not need to sign in.
REASON.appointment_not_carried: Making appointments was not carried over.
REASON.registration_not_carried: Sending answers to “{{plugin}}” was not carried over.
REASON.translations_not_carried: The translations were not carried over.
REASON.presentation_not_carried: The look of the source form was not carried over.
REASON.statement_of_truth_not_carried: The statement that the answers are true was not carried over.
REASON.privacy_policy_missing: The source form has no privacy policy link. Add one before you publish.
REASON.purpose_missing: The source form does not say why it collects data. Add a purpose before you publish.
REASON.retention_global_setting: The source form used a server-wide setting for how long answers are kept. Set a time yourself.
REASON.retention_method_not_carried: How the source form removes old answers was not carried over. Set how long you keep answers.
REASON.retention_other_limits_not_carried: Other limits on how long answers are kept were not carried over.
REASON.schedule_not_carried: The settings for when the form is open were not carried over.
REASON.error_messages_not_carried: The custom error messages were not carried over.
REASON.registration_attribute_not_carried: The link between this question and the registration was not carried over.
REASON.archive_entry_ignored: The file “{{key}}” in the zip was not read.
